title: Chinese Wordmark and Primary Logo Lockup Clearspace
slide_intent: Measure localized signatures from their own forms so spacing remains coherent across different scripts and lockup heights.
strategic_value: Character-based clearance can protect the Chinese Burger King identity without forcing an unrelated Latin unit.
demonstration: Two shaded diagrams show the Chinese wordmark and combined logo lockup with repeated Chinese character measuring units.
practical_value: Use the specified Chinese-character width, measuring vertical clearance of the lockup from the logo’s outer edges.

content_islands.name: Clearspace rule
content_islands.spec: Place the definition and vertical measurement note at left.

content_islands.name: Wordmark diagram
content_islands.spec: Place the standalone Chinese wordmark inside a shaded clearspace rectangle at upper right.

content_islands.name: Lockup diagram
content_islands.spec: Place the combined primary logo and Chinese wordmark in the lower diagram, with vertical clearance measured from the taller logo.

reference_purposes.Application: The Chinese character width defines minimum clearspace for both wordmark and lockup.
reference_purposes.Constraint: Top and bottom clearspace of the combined lockup is measured from the logo element’s edges.

ingredient.name: Chinese signature clearspace
ingredient.application: Reserve the stated Chinese-character width; measure top and bottom of the lockup from the primary logo edges.
ingredient.scope: Historical guide; the local character replaces the Burger U measurement used for Latin signatures.
